notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Priest of Titania.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G} and untapping it.
Repeat.
